title: Benefits and Allowances for Grassroots Leaders and Advisers
what_it_is: Benefits and Allowances for Grassroots Leaders and Advisers

sections.label: Grassroots leaders HDB flat scheme
sections.summary: Eligible grassroots leaders with three years of continuous active service can apply for HDB BTO flats and ECs in constituencies they serve, with an average of 28 utilising it yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Under this scheme, eligible grassroots leaders (GRLs) can apply for Housing and Development Board (HDB) Build-To-Order (BTO) flats and Executive Condominiums (ECs) in constituencies within the Town Council boundary which they serve.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: GRLs are eligible after performing three years of continuous and active service at their GROs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In the last 10 years, an average of 28 GRLs, or less than 0.1% of all GRLs, have utilised this scheme each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Are GRLs given priority in balloting for a flat, that is, are they given a higher queue number to select a flat of their choice?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Two, are they allowed to buy direct from HDB more than twice?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: And the last question is: are they also allowed to take a loan from HDB more than twice?

sections.label: Eligibility similar to other schemes
sections.summary: What they are eligible for is also similar to all the other schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: What they are eligible for is also similar to all the other schemes.
